g.textArea: Pounds become bags, bags round up to whole mixes, mixes become minutes. K4 picks the day for the printed plan.

rect.data-description: INPUT (typed). Typed dropdown = Tuesday. Feeds: K, L (so M, N, O Planned Total), Oven_Info Demand and pans, and both schedules through Planned Total.
FORMULA (this sheet). Q3 =TODAY(), R3 =TEXT(Q3,"dddd") = Friday. Printed only; does not pick the day.
FORMULA (this sheet). =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"})) = 54.5. Feeds: Breadline Schedule H2.
FORMULA (this sheet). O2 =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],"MCS LINE")) = 180. T2 =O1+O2 = 234.5. Feeds: MCS Schedule H2.

FORMULA (this sheet). Sunday: AD1 =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[S_Planned],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"})) = 48 bags; BD1 =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[S_Minutes],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"}))/60 = 8.5 h; AD2, BD2 the same for MCS LINE (174 bags, 16.08 h). Feed Daily Supply and Demand W1:W4.
FORMULA (this sheet). =COUNTA(Pans[Pans/Boxes]) = 41.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). In-house lines only (Asset Rank 1 to 3), not OBS, sorted by rank, dough, unique dough, SKU, with a dough header row above each block. =LET(rk,Products[Asset Rank],d,Products[Dough],p,Products[No.],u,Products[Unique Dough],gp,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],k,(rk<=3)*(d<>"")*(gp<>"OBS"),dg,FILTER(d,k),sk,FILTER(p,k),rr,FILTER(rk,k),ud,FILTER(u,k),srt,SORTBY(HSTACK(dg,sk),rr,1,dg,1,ud,1,sk,1),ds,INDEX(srt,0,1),ss,INDEX(srt,0,2),hdr,IF(ds<>VSTACK("",DROP(ds,-1)),ds,NA()),TOCOL(HSTACK(hdr,ss),2))
FORMULA (this sheet). =A7. D-codes are dough header rows.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Dough]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Unique Dough]),""). Groups rows into mixing runs.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Asset]),""). Line totals and schedule filters.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Dough[No.],Dough[Weight]),""). Filled on dough header rows (lb per bag).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Unique Dough],UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Bag]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Scrap Factor]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Dough[No.],Dough[Description]),XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Description])).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Packs Per Tray/Case]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Unique Dough],UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Time]),"").

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Packs (or cases) short on the K4 day, as a positive number. =IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D","",IFERROR(LET(d,MATCH($K$4,{"Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"},0),p,IF(LEFT([@Sku],2)="F5",XLOOKUP([@Sku],Dist_DSnD[Sku],CHOOSE(d,Dist_DSnD[S_Production],Dist_DSnD[M_Production],Dist_DSnD[T_Production],Dist_DSnD[W_Production],Dist_DSnD[TH_Production],Dist_DSnD[F_Production]),0),XLOOKUP([@Sku],DSD_DSnD[Sku],CHOOSE(d,DSD_DSnD[S_Production],DSD_DSnD[M_Production],DSD_DSnD[T_Production],DSD_DSnD[W_Production],DSD_DSnD[TH_Production],DSD_DSnD[F_Production]),0)),IF(p<0,ABS(p),"0")),"0"))

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Bags for this SKU: =IFERROR(ROUND(LET(d,MATCH($K$4,{"Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"},0),XLOOKUP([@Sku],DoughWeight[Sku],CHOOSE(d,DoughWeight[Sun],DoughWeight[Mon],DoughWeight[Tue],DoughWeight[Wed],DoughWeight[Thur],DoughWeight[Fri]))/XLOOKUP([@Dough],Dough[No.],Dough[Weight])),2)*[@Scrap Factor],"")

FORMULA (this sheet). Run total on the first row of each run, blank on the rest: =IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D","",LET(u,[@Unique Dough],IF(C6=u,"",SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Dough Weight],Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],u))))

FORMULA (this sheet). Rounds up to whole mixes; Marble x 2.5; dough rows sum their products: =IFERROR(IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D",SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Optimal Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Dough],[@Sku],Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],D8),IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),CEILING([@Bags By Unique Dough],[@optimal bags per mix])*2.5,CEILING([@Bags By Unique Dough],[@optimal bags per mix]))),"")
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@Optimal Total]. The one place to override the plan by typing. None are overridden today. Feeds: O1, O2, both schedules.

FORMULA (this sheet). P =[@Unique Dough], Q = Planned Total, R = Sku, S = Description, T = K. U =IFERROR(ROUNDUP([@Number of Individual Packaged Units Needed]/[@Units per case/Tray],0),""). V Tray or Case.

FORMULA (this sheet). Flags Case Total when a case is needed but its pack is not: =IF(LEFT([@Sku],2)<>"F5","",LET(n,N([@'#of Trays/Cases Needed]),base,XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Non Case Sku],""),bn,SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven['#of Trays/Cases Needed],Mix_Slice_Oven[Sku],base),IF(AND(n>0,bn=0),"Case Total","")))
ISSUE. Typed column meant for runouts. No formula reads it.
NOTE. Tuesday (K4): run total M = 1.298 bags, bags per mix 1, Optimal CEILING = 2, Planned 2, T_Minutes 2 / 1 x 30 = 60.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Sun Z:AD, Mon AE:AI, Tue AJ:AN, Wed AO:AS, Thu AT:AX, Fri AY:BC; minutes BD:BI. Sunday: =IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D","",IFERROR(LET(p,XLOOKUP([@Sku],DSD_DSnD[Sku],DSD_DSnD[S_Production]),IF(p<0,ABS(p),"0")),"0")). Reads DSD_DSnD only.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Sunday: =IFERROR(ROUND((XLOOKUP([@Sku],DoughWeight[Sku],DoughWeight[Sun])/XLOOKUP([@Dough],Dough[No.],Dough[Weight]))*[@Scrap Factor],2),""). Rounds after scrap; L rounds before.

FORMULA (this sheet). Run total per day: =IF([@Bags By Unique Dough]<>"",SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[S_Bags],Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],[@Unique Dough])*IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),2.5,1),"")

FORMULA (this sheet). =IFERROR(CEILING([@S_Raw],IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),2.5,[@optimal bags per mix])),""). T_Optimal holds the same formula in every cell.
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@S_Optimal]. Feeds: rows 1-2 totals.

FORMULA (this sheet). Sunday: =IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D","",IFERROR(([@S_Planned]/[@optimal bags per mix])*[@Run Time Per Mix (min)]/IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),2.5,1),0)). Rows 1-2 divide by 60 for hours.
NOTE. F_Needed 36 packs. F_Bags ROUND(47.25 / 177.27 x 1.1, 2) = 0.29. F_Raw 0.29, F_Optimal CEILING(0.29, 1) = 1, F_Minutes 1 / 1 x 30 = 30.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). One block per pan: the pan name, then every non-OBS product whose Pans/Boxes is that pan. =LET(pn,FILTER(Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pans/Boxes]<>""),sku,Products[No.],pan,Products[Pans/Boxes],gpg,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],DROP(REDUCE("",pn,LAMBDA(a,p,LET(m,FILTER(sku,(pan=p)*(gpg<>"OBS"),""),IF(AND(ROWS(m)=1,INDEX(m,1)=""),a,VSTACK(a,p,m))))),1))
FORMULA (this sheet). =A411.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IF(OR([@Finished Product]="",[@Finished Product]=0),"",IF(ISNUMBER(MATCH([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],0)),"Pan",XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Asset])))

rect.data-title: Unique Dough (C), Daily Bags Per Mix (D)
rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). C =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Unique Dough],,0),""). D =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Unique Dough],UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Bag]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Description]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Trays Per 1 bag Mix]),""). Filled on pan rows.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Packs short on the K4 day: the same formula as Mix_Slice_Oven K.
FORMULA (this sheet). Mislabelled copies: Sku =[@Today''s Date], Today's Date =[@Finished Product]. Both just repeat Finished Product.
NOT USED. A column literally named #N/A holding a copy of Demand. Nothing reads it.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Pieces Per Tray/Case]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pieces Per Pan]),""). Filled on pan rows.
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@Pans].

FORMULA (this sheet). On pan rows: pieces needed by every product on that pan, divided by pieces per pan, rounded up. =IFERROR(IF([@Pans]<>"Pan","",ROUNDUP(SUMPRODUCT(--(XLOOKUP(Oven_Info[Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Pans/Boxes],"")=[@Finished Product]),IFERROR(--Oven_Info[Demand],0),IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of pieces per tray/box],0))/[@Pieces Per Pan],0)),"") Feeds: MCS Schedule F29.
NOT USED. Blank. Nothing reads them.

FORMULA (this sheet). Text list of each pan and its products: =LET(pn,FILTER(Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pans/Boxes]<>""),sku,Products[No.],dsc,Products[Description],pan,Products[Pans/Boxes],DROP(REDUCE("",pn,LAMBDA(a,p,VSTACK(a,p,FILTER(" "&sku&" - "&dsc,pan=p," (no products assigned)"),""))),1))

rect.data-title: K4 says Tuesday, sheets say Friday
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Planned Total, the slice sheet, Oven_Info and both schedules show Tuesday quantities under a Friday date. Nothing ties K4 to TODAY().
ISSUE. Typing a runout in X changes no bag, minute or schedule.
ISSUE. Per-day _Needed reads DSD_DSnD only, so case rows show 0 packs needed even though their _Bags are counted.
ISSUE. L rounds bags before scrap; the _Bags columns round after scrap, so the K4 column and the same day block can differ by 0.01 bag per SKU.
ISSUE. Runs with a blank Optimal Time (5 artisan doughs among them) get 0 minutes, so line hours are understated.
ISSUE. Text in a number column: CEILING fails and the run gets no Optimal Total.
ISSUE. BK1 =1453/60: a typed minutes figure, not a formula.
ISSUE. K, _Needed and Demand return the text "0" when nothing is short, which SUM ignores and lookups treat as text.
ISSUE. Rows 453 to 477 fall outside the print area.

rect.data-title: Tables longer than the row list
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Mix_Slice_Oven +1 row, Oven_Info +18 rows (see Recon).

Tuesday"]:::input DW["DoughWeight lb
for the K4 day"]:::lookup DWT["Dough Weight
lb per bag"]:::lookup L["L Dough Weight
ROUND(lb / lb per bag, 2) x Scrap"]:::calc M["M Bags By Unique Dough
run total, first row only"]:::calc UD["Unique Dough
Optimal Bag, Optimal Time"]:::input N["N Optimal Total
CEILING to bags per mix
Marble x 2.5"]:::calc O["O Planned Total = Optimal
type here to override"]:::calc TOT["O1 Breadline, O2 MCS
T2 total bags"]:::calc SCH["MCS and Breadline
schedules"]:::output K["K packs short
DSD or Dist"]:::lookup SL["Slice sheet P:W
trays or cases"]:::output DAY["Per day: _Bags, _Raw,
_Optimal, _Planned"]:::calc MIN["_Minutes =
Planned / bags per mix x time"]:::calc HRS["Rows 1-2: bags and hours
per line per day"]:::calc DSD["Daily Supply and Demand
W1:W4"]:::lookup OD["Oven_Info Demand"]:::lookup PANS["Pans
pieces per pan"]:::input OP["Pans/Boxes to set out"]:::calc F29["MCS F29 pan list"]:::output XB["X Extra Bread (Runout)
read by nothing"]:::issue K4 --> L K4 --> K DW --> L DWT --> L L --> M M --> N UD --> N N --> O O --> TOT O --> SCH K --> SL DW --> DAY DAY --> MIN UD --> MIN MIN --> HRS HRS --> DSD K4 --> OD OD --> OP PANS --> OP OP --> F29
